Goyal urged the domestic industry to look beyond local markets and position India as a global manufacturing hub.

stories.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated India is on track to reach its $1 trillion export target for the current fiscal year. The country recorded $480 billion in goods and services exports between April and September 2026. Goyal described the annual goal as a sacrosanct target.

stories.title: European carmakers may soon manufacture in India
stories.summary: European automakers may establish local manufacturing units after testing demand under the India-EU free trade agreement, which takes effect in early 2027. stories.summary: Nissan Motor India reported 3,594 domestic dispatches in October 2026, a 37 percent increase year-on-year. stories.title: Mahindra to launch four new SUVs by mid-2027
stories.summary: Mahindra plans to introduce four new products by the end of June 2027. The lineup includes three all-new models and one refreshed vehicle. The first release is expected to arrive by the end of this calendar year, with test mules already spotted in production-ready form.

stories.title: Renault begins deliveries of Duster Hybrid
stories.summary: Renault has started delivering the Duster Strong Hybrid E-Tech 160 to Indian customers. The mid-size SUV features a 1.8-litre petrol engine, two electric motors, and a 1.4kWh battery. It produces 160bhp and claims an ARAI-certified mileage of 29kmpl. Prices for the vehicle start at Rs. 16.99 lakh.

stories.title: Car sales reach 5.24 lakh units in October
stories.summary: Car sales hit 5,24,226 units in October 2026, a 12.18 percent increase from the previous year. Maruti Suzuki led the market with 2,12,384 units, capturing a 40.51 percent share. Tata Motors and Mahindra finished just 556 units apart in the race for second place.

stories.title: Royal Enfield reveals Himalayan 750
stories.summary: Royal Enfield has unveiled the Himalayan 750, which features a 750cc parallel-twin engine. The motorcycle will debut at EICMA 2026 before its India launch at Motoverse in late November. It is expected to cost around Rs 4.50 lakh and will sit at the top of the brand lineup.

stories.title: TVS unveils Apache RTR 125 at EICMA
stories.summary: TVS has introduced the Apache RTR 125, a naked motorcycle featuring a 125cc liquid-cooled engine, dual-channel ABS, and smartphone-linked navigation. The bike produces 14.7bhp and uses a six-speed gearbox. An India launch for the model is currently under consideration by the company.

stories.title: Jupiter Wagons secures orders worth over 324 crore
stories.summary: Jupiter Wagons has secured orders exceeding 324 crore from GATX India and Chetak International. The company says these orders reflect growing interest in its ACT2 platform as private-sector participation in the rail freight ecosystem expands. Demand from private leasing companies and logistics operators continues to rise.

stories.title: TVS Ntorq 150 long-term review concludes
stories.summary: The long-term test of the TVS Ntorq 150 ended after 810km of use. The scooter recorded an overall efficiency of 40kmpl. Testers noted that the paint quality remained resilient despite exposure to North India's summer sun. The vehicle was subjected to various tests over several months.

stories.title: Hero Vida NEX 3 patent reveals wing-type door
stories.summary: Hero MotoCorp has filed a design patent in India for the Vida NEX 3, a two-seater micro-car concept first shown in 2025. The filing highlights an upward-opening wing-type door. The company has not confirmed whether it intends to move the urban mobility concept into production.

stories.title: Royal Enfield Himalayan 750 specs detailed
stories.summary: Royal Enfield has confirmed the Himalayan 750 features a 743cc parallel-twin engine producing 54bhp and 63Nm of torque. The adventure tourer includes adjustable Showa suspension and a six-axis IMU. While European bookings are open, the company has not yet confirmed a date for the Indian launch.

stories.title: EICMA 2026 highlights motorcycles headed to India
stories.summary: EICMA 2026 showcased new adventure tourers, performance roadsters, and electric motorcycles from brands including Royal Enfield, BMW, and Hero MotoCorp. Many of these models are expected to reach the Indian market over the coming years. Italian manufacturer Italjet is also preparing for a potential entry.

stories.title: Two-wheeler makers shift export focus to Latin America
stories.summary: Indian two-wheeler manufacturers are prioritizing Latin America over Africa for exports. Colombia is now the top destination, with shipments to the region rising significantly since FY22. Data from Kotak Institutional Equities shows exports to Colombia and Mexico grew by 87 percent and 83 percent respectively.

stories.title: KTM launches 1390 Super Duke GT Evo
stories.summary: KTM has unveiled the 2027 1390 Super Duke GT Evo, featuring a 1,350cc V-twin engine that produces 187hp. The motorcycle includes an Automated Manual Transmission and semi-active suspension. It is expected to reach international dealerships in early 2027, though India pricing and availability remain unconfirmed.

stories.title: Hyundai plans compact electric SUV for 2027
stories.summary: Hyundai is developing a compact electric SUV, internally codenamed HE1i, expected to launch in India by March 2027. The vehicle will be manufactured in Tamil Nadu and aims to compete in the mass-market segment. It is expected to be offered with two battery options.

stories.title: Mahindra executive targets one million EV sales
stories.summary: Suman Mishra, CEO of Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, aims to reach one million electric vehicle sales by 2031. The company is focusing on accessible finance and servicing to support drivers. Mishra stated that the transition must prioritize improving the livelihoods of those who drive for a living.

stories.title: Staffordshire announces 4.6 million EV charging plan
stories.summary: Staffordshire County Council is launching a 4.6 million programme to expand electric vehicle charging in car parks and community locations. The initiative uses Government Local Electric Vehicle Infrastructure funding to help residents without driveways access charging. Investment will be directed based on local feedback and evidence.

stories.title: EVs displaced 2.3 million barrels of oil daily in 2025
stories.summary: Electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles displaced 2.3 million barrels of oil consumption per day in 2025, according to BloombergNEF. The firm projects this figure will more than double by the end of the decade as global sales of battery-powered vehicles continue to climb.

stories.title: Xiaomi reports decline in combined vehicle sales
stories.summary: Xiaomi has experienced a decline in combined sales for its SU7 and YU7 models for the fourth consecutive month. The company continues to navigate the competitive electric vehicle market. Full details regarding the sales performance are available to subscribers.

stories.title: Renault develops electric military robot
stories.summary: Renault has partnered with John Cockerill to develop the Forefront, an unmanned ground vehicle designed for defense and civilian operations. The concept features a 249-mile range. The project combines Renault's manufacturing capabilities with the defense expertise of its Belgian partner.

stories.title: Chery prepares winter-adapted SUV for Canada
stories.summary: Chinese automaker Chery is preparing an electric SUV adapted for winter conditions for the Canadian market. The company is currently navigating international expansion strategies. Further details regarding the vehicle's specifications and market entry are available to Bloomberg subscribers.

stories.title: Tesla China sales drop 66 percent
stories.summary: Tesla delivered 8,817 cars to Chinese buyers in October, a 66 percent decline from last year. While total wholesale figures rose 10.3 percent to 67,829 vehicles, 59,012 of those were exported. The Shanghai factory ran normally, but the domestic market took a smaller share.

stories.title: India electric vehicle retail sales hit record high
stories.summary: Electric vehicle retail sales in India reached 3,54,625 units in October 2026, a 44.88 percent increase from the previous year. Growth was led by electric two-wheelers and three-wheelers, with data collated from 1,468 regional transport offices across the country.

stories.title: Ford tracks 36,000 EVs to monitor battery health
stories.summary: Ford analyzed data from 36,000 electric SUVs over five years to address concerns regarding battery longevity. The automaker reported that average battery health remains at 92 percent after two billion miles of driving. Modern battery packs appear to maintain capacity in everyday conditions.

stories.title: India electric passenger vehicle sales grow 76 percent
stories.summary: Retail sales of electric passenger vehicles in India rose 76.47 percent to 37,049 units in October 2026. These vehicles now account for 7.3 percent of total passenger vehicle retail, though this penetration rate remains below the 8.5 percent recorded in September.

stories.title: India commercial vehicle market shows split performance
stories.summary: Goods-carrier registrations rose 21.4 percent to 9.05 lakh between January and October 2026, while bus registrations saw only marginal growth. The data suggests the national transport system is prioritizing the movement of goods over shared passenger mobility.

stories.title: Heavy trucks and electric vehicles drive industry growth
stories.summary: Goods-carrier registrations rose 21.4 percent to 9.05 lakh between January and October 2026, while bus registrations grew 1.8 percent to 1.13 lakh. Electric commercial vehicle registrations surged 162.3 percent in October, accounting for 4.29 percent of total retail sales.

stories.title: Tata Motors and Iveco Group launch joint business
stories.summary: Tata Motors and Iveco Group have combined their commercial vehicle operations, creating a company ranked fourth globally. The new entity spans Europe, India, South America, Asia, the Middle East and Africa. N Chandrasekaran described the move as the start of a new phase.

stories.title: Four killed in Chitrakoot tractor accident
stories.summary: Four pilgrims were killed and 12 injured after a tractor-trolley overturned in Chitrakoot on Monday. The accident occurred when the connecting hook detached from the tractor, causing the overloaded trolley to become uncontrollable. The victims were returning home from Diwali celebrations.

stories.title: One killed in Purvanchal Expressway collision
stories.summary: One person died and 16 were injured after a truck hit a tractor-trolley on the Purvanchal Expressway on Tuesday. The victims were migrant workers returning to Bihar. The collision was described by police as forceful enough to throw passengers onto the roadway.

stories.title: Mexico auto parts production reaches record high
stories.summary: Mexico's auto parts production reached US $11.118 billion in August, a 9.1 percent year-over-year increase. This marks the highest monthly production value on record for the industry. Total production for the first eight months of 2026 reached $85.8 billion.

stories.summary: A fire in Jaora destroyed a tyre shop and a car on Tuesday, spreading to an adjoining auto parts store. Municipal firefighting efforts were delayed by technical problems with two fire tenders. A third tender eventually contained the blaze.

stories.summary: Dutch chipmaker Nexperia is oversubscribed as manufacturers prioritize AI data centers over mature chips used in cars. stories.title: South Africa faces AGOA withdrawal
stories.summary: The US intends to end South Africa's AGOA eligibility on 1 January 2027. Automotive exports to the US previously fell 29 percent following the introduction of Section 232 tariffs. Products will now face standard import duties of approximately 2.5 percent.

stories.title: Dorman expands auto parts portfolio
stories.summary: Dorman Products has introduced an aluminum engine oil filter housing for select Genesis, Hyundai and Kia vehicles. The part replaces original plastic components that the company claims deteriorate under engine heat. The product is marketed as a solution to a recurring failure.

stories.summary: Exide Technologies will present its automotive battery range at Automechanika Dubai from November 10 to 12. The event is the largest automotive aftermarket platform in the MEA region.

stories.summary: Toyota topped JudgeService’s first brand-level ranking of franchised dealer networks with a Net Promoter Score of 89. stories.title: Dealers risk losing sales by delaying lead follow-up
stories.summary: Impel analysed over 549,000 UK leads and found that 28 percent of customer engagements occurred more than 48 hours after the initial enquiry. The company noted that it took an average of 3.7 outreach attempts to generate an engagement. Some customers are apparently not waiting.

stories.title: Smaller cities account for most passenger vehicle sales growth
stories.summary: Non-metro urban markets added over 389,000 vehicles to registrations in the 10 months leading to October, accounting for 55 percent of incremental sales. These markets now hold a 57.3 percent share of total passenger vehicle registrations in India, outpacing growth in both rural and metro areas.

stories.summary: Infor has updated its CloudSuite Automotive and distribution software to include AI agents that handle tasks like checking material shortages and generating quotes. The certifications were awarded at a ceremony at the company headquarters in the Republic of Korea.

stories.summary: ServiceUp has introduced an AI voice agent that calls repair shops to check on overdue vehicle repairs and logs the data into repair records. The company says this allows fleet managers to focus on strategy. The agent handles the calls, but the managers retain the control.

stories.summary: Federal regulators have opened a recall query into 2,895 Waymo vehicles following continued violations involving school buses. stories.summary: Synopsys has collaborated with Infineon to deliver a virtual development kit for the AURIX RC1 microcontroller. stories.summary: Pakistan's new auto policy is facing backlash from the domestic parts industry, which warns the import-centric approach could threaten 300,000 jobs. stories.title: Analysis warns of emissions impact from EV target cuts
stories.summary: Weakening the UK Zero Emissions Vehicle Mandate could result in 7.5 million tonnes of additional carbon emissions in Scotland by 2050, according to the Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit. research.title: Agibot: An Open-Source Modular Swerve-Drive Robot Platform for Agricultural Robotics Research and Education
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Agricultural production faces persistent labor shortages and increasing demand for automation, yet progress in agricultural robotics remains constrained by the limited availability of affordable, flexible, and accessible research platforms. This paper presents Agibot, an open-source, modular. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Beyond Semantic Classes: Online Physical Parameter Estimation via Embedding-Conditioned Gaussian Mixtures
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Enabling robots to infer interaction-relevant physical properties from vision before contact would improve planning and control in unstructured environments. Vision provides useful pre-contact information, but appearance alone is often ambiguous: visually similar regions can induce different. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning with Massively Parallel Simulation for Low-Thrust Multi-Revolution Rendezvous
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The growing demand for on-orbit servicing and constellation management in low Earth orbit requires autonomous and reliable low-thrust rendezvous. Traditional numerical methods struggle with the long-horizon nature of multi-revolution maneuvers under perturbations, while standard deep reinforcement. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Dynamic Traffic Modeling using Equivalent Circuit Models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents an equivalent circuit model (ECM) for dynamic traffic modeling by exploiting analogies between electrical and transportation variables. Vehicle concentration is represented by capacitor voltage, while traffic flow is modeled using controllable current sources. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Efficient Learning of Differentiable MPC Policies on the GPU via Smoothed ADMM and First-Order Reinforcement Learning
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Differentiable model predictive control (MPC) enables structured, constraint-aware policies to be optimized end-to-end. However, learning MPC policies faces two bottlenecks: (1) nonsmooth sensitivities at active-set transitions and (2) expensive policy evaluation, since each requires an optimization. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: EmbodiedIntentBench: Benchmarking Intent-Driven Runtime Adaptation for Mobile Robotic Missions
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile robotic sensing systems must adapt to operator requirements, limited resources, changing connectivity, and observation opportunities shaped by physical motion. Evaluating runtime strategies therefore requires assessing whether their decisions fulfill mission objectives, beyond isolated perception accuracy. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: GFM Control Automatic Compliance Toolbox
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The increasing penetration of converter-interfaced generation reduces system inertia, short-circuit strength, and voltage support. European grid codes, including the ENTSO-E Network Code on Requirements for Generators and the ACER Demand Connection Code, now define disturbance-based validation. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Mobility Information Capacity of Multi-Robot Systems: Safety-Aware Maneuver Design
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiple robots operating in shared workspaces must adjust their speed, direction, and trajectories to coordinate with one another and respond to changing tasks and disturbances. The available maneuver freedom depends on the dynamics, uncertainty, and safety. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
